scope: Implement approved DCR-2026-004 by adding optional Board SKU, GPU SKU, and Board Architecture fields to permission-aware label printing and centering the physical label on every print page without changing the label size or database schema.

evidence: backend/src/labels.ts validates the supported field list and rejects customized layouts from users without an elevated role
frontend/src/components/LabelPrint.test.tsx verifies customization for Super Users and Privileged Administrators and hides those controls from regular Users
backend/src/labels.ts records the selected field list on the parent label job and each navigable asset print event
backend/test/labels-contract.test.ts verifies preview and audited print routes remain separate
frontend/src/components/LabelPrint.tsx uses one physical renderer for preview and print and includes PostgreSQL-backed model metadata only when selected
frontend/src/styles.css keeps the 2.125 inch by 1 inch page, centers the print root and physical label, and preserves one page break per included asset
frontend/src/components/LabelPrint.test.tsx verifies one physical label per selected asset and the three new optional field controls
backend/test/labels-contract.test.ts verifies supported model fields, stable defaults, and centered physical print rules
The candidate is packaged as a component-aware delta from verified production 1.3.13 to 1.3.14
No database migration, PostgreSQL restart, baseline installer, or retained backup is introduced
